title: Mili
desc: Curmudgeonly Shekhar is new to the block, and it doesn't take long before the street noise, as well as the children playing nearby, push his tolerance to the limit. To the rescue comes Mili who has the exact opposite disposition.

title: Izzat
desc: Constable Ram Chandra teaches his son Siddharth to be a diligent policeman and lead his life with honesty and dignity. Siddharth follows his advice until circumstances force him to leave his ideals.

title: Ghar Ka Chiraag
desc: A wealthy widower marries the daughter of a school principal when her lover is assumed dead. Years later, her partner returns and sets out to find the truth behind her marriage.
